title.narrative: Community-led Innovation for Climate Risk Mitigation in Bangladesh (CLIMB)

description.narrative: The project facilitated innovation-focused Climate Vulnerability and Capacity Analysis to identify community challenges, while organising workshops with young participants to specify them. Supporting two youth groups to prototype hydroponics structures, the project initiated hydroponics cultivation, adding value by promoting alternative and climate-smart innovations. Locally made organic nutrient solutions enhanced vegetable growth, contributing to food security of both host and refugees (Rohingya).
